facts.fact: A Council of Ministers draft bill on the national information system, issued 8 October 2022 over the Prime Minister's signature and marked as a draft (مشروع), gives every citizen a right to request information from public bodies' information units, with refusal reasons, a complaint to the General Information Authority and recourse to the courts; it is not shown as enacted.
facts.system: Draft law on the National Information System (مشروع قانون بشأن النظام الوطني للمعلومات), 2022
